svg.desc: Schematic route, not to scale. Read elements in order. Rope lengths are supplied declarations, not equipment requirements. 1. Rappel R1. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: bolts. Anchor count: 1. Physical height: 10m. Landing: pool. Declared rope: 20m. Station: left. 2. Rappel R2. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: natural. Anchor count: 2. Physical height: 10m. Landing: ledge. Declared rope: 20m. Station: right. 3. Rappel R3. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: tree. Anchor count: 3. Physical height: 10m. Landing: dry. Declared rope: 20m. Station: center. 4. Rappel R4. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: thread. Anchor count: 4. Physical height: 10m. Landing: chaos. Declared rope: 20m. Station: floor. 5. Rappel R5. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: removable. Anchor count: 5. Physical height: 10m. Landing: gallery. Declared rope: 20m. Station: tree. 6. Rappel R6. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: fixed. Anchor count: 6. Physical height: 10m. Landing: trail. Declared rope: 20m. Station: natural. 7. Rappel R7. Movement: descent. Vertical change: -10m. Anchor type: unknown. Anchor count: 7. Physical height: 10m. Landing: unknown. Declared rope: 20m. Station: unknown. 8. svg.text: Schematic, not to scale. Read sections top to bottom and match
Arrow: traversal direction. Short ticks: stage boundaries.
Diamonds: redirections. Double ticks: station side. Zigzag:
compressed walking/swimming distance. Text retains declared
